title: Using These and Those
prompt: Describe the difference between 'these' and 'those' when talking about plural nouns.
hint: Use 'these' for plural nouns close to you, and 'those' for plural nouns far from you.
sample: 'These are flowers' means the flowers are near, while 'Those are flowers' means the flowers are far away.

ja.prompt: 複数の名詞について話すとき、『these』と『those』の違いを説明してください。
ja.hint: 『these』は近くにある複数の名詞に使い、『those』は遠くにある複数の名詞に使います。
ja.sample: 『These are flowers』は花が近くにあることを意味し、『Those are flowers』は花が遠くにあることを意味します。

title: Negative Sentences with These and Those
prompt: Make negative sentences using 'these' and 'those' with plural nouns.
hint: Use the contraction 'aren't' (are not) to make negative sentences with 'these' and 'those'.
sample: 'These aren't flowers' means the items near you are not flowers. 'Those aren't flowers' means the items far away are not flowers.

ja.prompt: 複数の名詞に対して、『these』と『those』を使った否定文を作ってください。
ja.hint: 『these』と『those』の否定文には、短縮形の『aren't』（are not）を使います。
ja.sample: 『These aren't flowers』は近くのものが花ではないことを意味し、『Those aren't flowers』は遠くのものが花ではないことを意味します。

title: Questions with These and Those
prompt: Form questions using 'these' and 'those' with plural nouns.
hint: Invert the verb 'are' and the subject 'these' or 'those' to make questions.
sample: 'Are these flowers?' asks if the nearby items are flowers. 'Are those flowers?' asks if the far items are flowers.

ja.hint: 疑問文を作るときは、動詞の『are』と主語の『these』または『those』を入れ替えます。
ja.sample: 『Are these flowers?』は近くのものが花かどうかを尋ね、『Are those flowers?』は遠くのものが花かどうかを尋ねます。
